node.title: Re^3: system commands/shell and perl variables.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Since I don't have that program, could you perhaps show the output of a typical xl list command, and show and explain the expected output for that input (both in tags)? See also [id://174051] and [id://1177642]. Also note the [id://745674], where it is mentioned that you can and should use a module such as [doc://Data::Dumper] to show what your variables contain.
